c_vs_historical_e2b_full_gain.interpretation: Descriptive, non-additive episode transitions; categories can overlap and do not identify a causal mechanism.

pairwise_inference_note: All exact McNemar p-values are two-sided, unadjusted, and exploratory; 21 correlated tests are reported without multiplicity correction.

quality.historical_provenance_limit: Historical source evaluations lack suite hashes and per-episode identities; their replay-complete audits are aligned by immutable ordered replay. Paired historical comparisons inherit this weaker lineage and must not be described as identity-bound source evaluations.

selection_gate.rule: preserve no-error; require zero faulted final-state false interventions; maximize stable exact
